pages.text: $(o)...if you are reading this, you have walked as far as we did.$(br2)What Vael became we call the $(l)Hollow Sovereign$(). He sleeps, but sleep is not peace.$()
pages.title: The Final Fragment

pages.text: $(o)He can be woken. An altar raised here, in the Hollow, ringed in the black stone and lit with candles. Offer him a heart made of his own stone.$(br2)Do not do this unless you mean to end him.$(br2)We could not.$()
